_readme: VTEX target knowledge. SEED, not stable: both lists were derived from general platform knowledge. VTEX has no single versioned API - each service (Catalog, Pricing, Logistics, Checkout, OMS, Master Data, Sessions, Payments) has its own endpoints, its own pub/pvt scopes and its own authentication, and several capabilities ship as apps rather than as platform endpoints. Re-verify every path against developers.vtex.com for the account's current app versions, and re-verify block names against the installed versions of the vtex-apps store components.
target_api_endpoint_families: Catalog: /api/catalog_system/pub/products/search (storefront product search, legacy), /api/catalog_system/pub/category/tree/{level}, /api/catalog_system/pvt/product, /api/catalog/pvt/product/{id}, /api/catalog/pvt/stockkeepingunit (SKU maintenance)
Intelligent Search: /api/io/_v/api/intelligent-search/product_search/{facets} and /api/io/_v/api/intelligent-search/facets (storefront search, autocomplete, merchandising rules)

Checkout (orderForm): /api/checkout/pub/orderForm/{orderFormId}, /items, /items/update, /attachments/clientProfileData, /attachments/shippingData, /attachments/paymentData, /coupons, /customData - orderForm is the cart and the single source of truth
Checkout (order placement): /api/checkout/pub/orders, /api/checkout/pub/orderForm/{id}/transaction, /api/checkout/pub/orderForms/simulation (price and shipping simulation)

OMS: /api/oms/pvt/orders (list and search), /api/oms/pvt/orders/{orderId} (order detail), /api/oms/user/orders (customer order history), /api/oms/pvt/orders/{orderId}/invoice, /cancel, /changes (invoicing, cancellation, order changes)
OMS integration: order hook (/api/orderhook/config) and the order feed v3 (/api/orderhook/feed) - the sanctioned way to receive order events instead of polling
Master Data v2: /api/dataentities/{acronym}/documents, /api/dataentities/{acronym}/search, /api/dataentities/{acronym}/schemas/{schema} (custom entities, customer profiles CL, addresses AD)
Pricing v2: /pricing/prices/{skuId}, /pricing/pipeline/catalog/... , /pricing/prices/{skuId}/fixed/{tradePolicyId} (list price, fixed prices per trade policy, price tables)

Logistics: /api/logistics/pvt/inventory/skus/{skuId}, /api/logistics/pvt/inventory/balance, /api/logistics/pvt/shipping/configuration/freights, /api/logistics/pvt/configuration/docks|warehouses|carriers (inventory and shipping configuration)
Sessions and segmentation: /api/sessions, /api/segments (the storefront context: channel/trade policy, locale, currency, logged-in state)
Profile System / customer data: /api/profile-system/profiles/{email} plus the CL and AD Master Data entities
Rates and Benefits (promotions and taxes): /api/rnb/pvt/calculatorconfiguration, /api/rnb/pvt/benefits/calculatorconfiguration, /api/rnb/pvt/coupon (promotions and coupons)
Payments: Payment Provider Protocol (a partner implements it to become a gateway), /api/payments/pvt/transactions, /api/payments/pvt/transactions/{id}/payments
Subscriptions: /api/rns/pub/subscriptions and /api/rns/pvt/subscriptions (recurring orders)
License Manager / access: /api/license-manager/pvt/accounts, users and roles; appKey/appToken headers (X-VTEX-API-AppKey / AppToken) for server-to-server calls
Marketplace and sellers: /api/seller-register/pvt/sellers, /api/fulfillment/pvt/orders (fulfilment-side order intake), /api/mkt-suggestions (SKU suggestions between marketplace and seller)
Reviews and Ratings: /api/reviews-and-ratings/api/reviews (app-provided API)
VTEX IO GraphQL app APIs: store-graphql, search-graphql, vtex.store-resources events - the storefront's real data layer under Store Framework

B2B Suite (apps, GraphQL): vtex.b2b-organizations (organizations, cost centers, roles), vtex.b2b-quotes (quotes and negotiation), vtex.b2b-checkout-settings - capabilities delivered as apps, not as platform endpoints
Legacy CMS / Layout API: /api/portal/pvt/sites and template endpoints (only for accounts still on the legacy CMS)
Suggestions and catalog integration: /api/suggestions, /api/catalog_system/pvt/sku/stockkeepingunitids (bulk catalog integration paths)
target_content_component_types: page block root: store.home, store.product, store.search, store.custom#<page>, store.orderplaced, store.account
layout block: flex-layout.row / flex-layout.col
layout block: slider-layout (carousel of any blocks)
layout block: tab-layout / tab-list / tab-content
layout block: sticky-layout, modal-layout, condition-layout (personalised/conditional rendering)
layout block: responsive-layout.desktop / .phone / .tablet
content block: rich-text
content block: image / image-list (with link and Site Editor content)
content block: info-card
content block: html / raw-html (escape hatch)
content block: shelf / shelf.relatedProducts (legacy) and list-context.product-list (current product lists)
content block: product-summary (product card composition: product-summary-image, -name, -price, -sku-selector, buy-button)
product page block: product-images, product-name, product-price, product-description, product-specifications, sku-selector, product-quantity, add-to-cart-button, product-availability
search block: search-result-layout (desktop/mobile/preview), filter-navigator, order-by, gallery, total-products, breadcrumb
navigation block: menu / menu-item, category-menu, breadcrumb, vtex.store-drawer
cart and checkout block: minicart.v2, checkout (hosted checkout UI), order-placed
account block: my-account and its child blocks (orders, addresses, profile, subscriptions)
Site Editor content record (per-binding, per-page block content and props edited by merchants)
Master Data entity record used as content (custom content entities with a schema)
custom React component inside a VTEX IO app (the only way to add a new block type)
FastStore component / CMS section (headless frontend - does NOT render Store Framework blocks)
legacy CMS: layout, template and control (only on accounts still on the legacy CMS)

_stamp.source: seed from general platform knowledge, to be verified
